name: React Renderer
description: UI rendering vessel — resolves ui_component impulses to React primitives; provides synthesize-ui-from-data and UI pattern activities

tools.name: browser_inspect
tools.description: Inspect the react-renderer browser viewport at http://localhost:3001/app. Use 'screenshot' to capture a PNG, 'snapshot' to get the DOM outline, 'content' to read page text, or 'navigate' to open a URL. Essential for validating that render_ui calls produced the expected output.

action.description: screenshot: save PNG to .playwright-mcp/. snapshot: get DOM outline. content: get page text. navigate: open URL and confirm.

url.description: URL to visit. Defaults to http://localhost:3001/app

outputPath.description: File path for screenshot. Defaults to .playwright-mcp/ui-<timestamp>.png

waitMs.description: Extra wait after page load in ms. Defaults to 1500.

tools.name: render_ui
tools.description: Push a UI primitive to the connected browser viewport at http://localhost:3001/app. Supported types: container (layout wrapper — supports layout: vertical|horizontal|grid|absolute; sizing: width, height, maxWidth, minHeight; grid: columns; flex: justify, align, wrap; style: background, border, borderRadius, naked), text (variant: heading|subheading|body|caption, format: plain|markdown), badge (variant: success|warning|error|info|neutral), button (variant: primary|secondary|destructive|ghost), progress (progressType: bar|circle|gauge, value 0-100), code (language, showLineNumbers), data-table (columns array, data array), data-table-v2 (TanStack virtual table), chart (chartType: bar|line|pie|area|gauge|sparkline), form (fields array, steps array for wizard), design_token (content: CSS custom property map applied to :root).

primitive.description: The primitive spec to render. Must have 'type'. Supported types: container (layout wrapper with children), text (markdown/heading/body), badge (status chip), button (clickable), progress (bar/circle), code (syntax-highlighted block), data-table (sortable table with columns+data arrays).

position.description: Optional layout position. Defaults to flow (stacked). Use absolute for precise x/y placement, center for centered overlay.

layer.description: Z-index layer. Higher numbers render on top. Use 0 for base content, 10+ for overlays, 100+ for modals.
